note: Normalizer registry. Every normalizer used by a casefile must be registered here with a documented, tested, narrow scope. Normalization is ONLY for fields the public contract explicitly leaves nondeterministic: process ids, fd numbers, random endpoint tokens, absolute addresses, monotonic timestamps, and scheduler-dependent ordering where multiple valid orders are permitted by the contract.

normalizers.scope: event.fd, descriptor numbers reported by platform_handle_wrap/unwrap
normalizers.rule: replace fd numbers with 'FD' (identity is tracked separately by the harness token)
normalizers.narrowness: only fd number fields; descriptor identity/closure state is NOT normalized

normalizers.rule: replace with elapsed ms since case start
normalizers.narrowness: only timestamp fields; ordering is preserved

normalizers.scope: random endpoint/port tokens in event outputs
normalizers.rule: replace with deterministic token derived from sequence position

normalizers.scope: drain_trap_events ordering when multiple triggers are simultaneously satisfiable
normalizers.rule: sort events by (trigger_context) when the casefile declares multi-trigger nondeterminism
normalizers.narrowness: only applied when the casefile declares 'permitted_orders': ['trigger_context']
